title: Why The Bully Was Really So Mean 🤖 Ep.3 (Finale)
endcard: THE END… FOR NOW 🤖 NEW STORY TOMORROW

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Six p.m. Nix's house. The doorbell rang. Bruno stood there… holding flowers. FLOWERS.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Your mom said I shouldn't come empty-handed. The florist said these mean friendship. I panicked.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Beta, come in, come in! You look like you haven't eaten a home meal in YEARS.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that's when Bruno went quiet. Really quiet.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: My mom works night shifts at the hospital. Nobody cooks at our place. It's usually… just me and the microwave.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait. That's why you always mocked my lunch? Because…

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Because it smelled like somebody loved you, man. And that annoyed me. I guess I wanted it to be annoying.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Beta Bruno. From today, Friday dinners. Both of you. No excuses. And bring your mother when she's free.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Aunty… I don't know what to say.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Say nothing. Eat. That's the rule of this house.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three servings later, Bruno was teaching Milli how to do his victory dance. Badly. Very badly.

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: You're doing it WRONG, Bruno! Even Dada dances better, and he's asleep!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that's how the school's toughest bully became family number eight at our table.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Follow the NixFam. Tomorrow… a completely new story begins. And trust me— it involves a missing exam paper.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Biryani Incident: closed. New mystery: loading.
